skills.label: Workspace Foundation
skills.description: Build a portable workspace with useful agent capabilities.
skills.reads: Workspace files, agent instruction files, ignore rules, and the list of available tools/MCPs.
skills.writes: Workspace scaffold files, after showing the proposed content and getting approval.
skills.notes: Auditing a workspace can surface credential-shaped files; the skill reports them instead of reading their contents. Connecting a recommended tool or MCP may lead the user into a separate login, which is their explicit step, not this skill's.

skills.label: Email Digest
skills.description: Turn recent mail into a useful recurring digest.
skills.reads: The contents of a mailbox the user has already connected, over that account's existing access.
skills.writes: The digest and the user's local digest preferences.
skills.notes: Reading mail is a sensitive read of personal correspondence and needs a working mail connection. The skill neither sends mail nor modifies the mailbox; account setup stays with the user.

skills.label: Workspace Hygiene
skills.description: Keep an agent workspace tidy and trustworthy.
skills.reads: The whole workspace, including scratch notes, indexes, and instruction files.
skills.writes: Moves, archives, and — only on explicit approval of the exact targets — deletes workspace files.
skills.notes: The only skill here that can remove user files. Every move or deletion is previewed, archiving is preferred over deletion, and deletion requires approval of the exact targets.

skills.label: Workspace Learning
skills.description: Turn real corrections into durable rules.
skills.reads: Card threads, completed work, and corrections the user has authorized as learning sources.
skills.writes: Observation notes and, after approval, rule files that shape future runs.
skills.notes: Work history is sensitive content, and promoted rules change how future agents behave, so promotion is always the user's decision.
